name: VAs, Admin & Operations
intro: Assistants, coordinators and operations managers who keep the calendar, the inbox and the day-to-day running so you can focus on the business.

roleDetails.text: Manages your calendar, inbox and travel, preps you for meetings, and follows up on what comes out of them.
Handles scheduling, data entry, document prep and the routine admin that keeps an office running.
Keeps projects and processes on track: tracks tasks, coordinates with vendors and makes sure handoffs between teams don't stall.
Runs the day-to-day operation, sets up the processes and tools, and manages the people who keep it moving.
Plans the work, sets timelines, keeps everyone updated and makes sure projects ship on time and on budget.
Takes on a mix of admin, research, customer emails and scheduling, wherever your team needs another pair of hands.
